formulas.unmet_need_note: Matches Tabel16 col10 JUMLAH UNMET NEED; excludes ingin segera (cols 4,7)
formulas.mcpr_proxy: total_modern (Tabel11 col12) / jumlah_pus (Tabel10) * 100 — confirm vs SIGA mCPR definition
formulas.pct_4t_note: terlalu_muda (<20), terlalu_tua (>=35), terlalu_dekat (<2 thn), terlalu_banyak (>3 anak) — jumlah_bumil_4t is unique count (not sum of components)
formulas.tabel1_source: Tabel1.xlsx — JUMLAH IBU HAMIL (BUMIL) TEREGISTER … KATEGORI 4T
formulas.ktd: hamil_tial (Tabel16 col HAMIL · TIDAK INGIN ANAK LAGI) — count, not percent
formulas.ktd_note: KTD = pregnant and does not want another child (hamil_tial). Nasional = sum of 38 Provinsi.
formulas.demand_satisfied_note: Demand Satisfied %; unmet_need = unique unmet count (calc_unmet / jumlah_unmet_need), not %
formulas.mii_note: IC_baru+IC_ulangan from Tabel2 (suntik,implan,IUD,vasektomi,tubektomi). denom_baru=Tabel3 selected (suntik 1bln+3komb+3prog + implan 1+2 batang + IUD + vasektomi + tubektomi; exclude pil & kondom). denom_ulangan=Tabel10 KB ulangan (suntik+implan+IUD); vasektomi/tubektomi columns absent in this Excel — treated as 0.
formulas.mii_sources: Tabel2.xlsx + Tabel3.xlsx + Tabel10_v3.xlsx (KB ulangan; different from PUS Tabel10)
formulas.mkjp_note: MKJP methods = IUD+Implan+Vasektomi+Tubektomi. mkjp_baru from Tabel3 (implan 1+2 batang + IUD + vasektomi + tubektomi); total_baru = Tabel3 jumlah KB baru. mkjp_ulangan from Tabel10 KB ulangan (implan+IUD only; vasektomi/tubektomi cols absent → 0); total_ulangan = Tabel10 jumlah KB ulangan.
formulas.mkjp_sources: Tabel3.xlsx + Tabel10_v3.xlsx (KB ulangan; different from PUS Tabel10)
